description:
Hushfeed v0.67.0 has 106 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer.

## What's changed

* TikTok's "Videos you might like" pushes, the ones like "25M+ people viewed", are blocked by the new Block suggested video notifications patch. It's on from the first launch, and its switch under Inbox lets them through again. Messages, comments, likes, follows and videos from accounts you follow aren't touched.
* Stop saving search history is new too. With Privacy > Don't save new searches on, new searches stay out of the history TikTok keeps on your phone.
* Feed text sizes gives the video description and the creator's name their own sizes on the Feed screen page (#66).
* The LIVE feed you open with the LIVE button can be filtered now (#57).
* Hide profile shortcuts takes the shortcuts you pick off the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders (#49).
* Stop TikTok's benchmark runs, on the Privacy page, keeps TikTok's phone benchmark from starting in the background (#64).
* Streaks take several usernames, separated by commas or new lines (#73), and Hushfeed's settings come in Azerbaijani (#77).
* Hide search rewards keeps the floating coin off search along with the points banner (#21). Restart TikTok after you change it.
* Hide the status bar, and a new Hide the comment bar on opened videos switch, work on videos you open from a profile, a hashtag, a sound or search (#50).
* A double tap, long press or swipe set to open comments goes to the video on screen, not the one you just left. The other long press actions do too (#63).
* Show author region puts the country on the video you're watching after a swipe down (#75).
* Hide the music line also hides the "Contains:" song credit (#68). Share actions you've excluded by name stay hidden after the sheet reopens (#74).
* With Download original photos on, Download video on a photo post saves the original images instead of TikTok's watermarked video (#71).
* Hushfeed works in a copy of TikTok made with Morphe's Clone app patch (#59), and the resource optimizers accept an APK split down to one ABI (#43).
* Remove unused language packs keeps every language unless you list the ones you want (#67). If you patched with an older bundle, check what that option says.
* Hide CAPTCHA popups isn't available for now, so every verification challenge stays visible.
* About > Build details copies or saves what your build was patched with, and automatic reports include it.
* Hushfeed is built with Morphe patcher 1.15.0 now, which is why it needs Manager 1.33.0. In a test with memory held near what Manager gets on a phone, the new patcher finished saving patched TikTok 47.1.4 where the old one ran out of memory.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFeed/blob/v0.67.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2733 runtime tests and 533 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 106 patches applied to all three supported APKs. Resource checks passed, and the manifest changes are the reviewed ones from earlier releases. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* On a Samsung phone running TikTok 47.0.3, the music line, the share sheet exclusions and photo post saves were checked by hand.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. An older Manager says the bundle needs a Manager update. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 or 47.1.4 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.67.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.
